Sure! To change the email address that receives your invoices:
1. Open **Settings → Billing → Recipients** in your workspace.
2. Add a new billing contact email or replace the existing one. You can add multiple recipients (e.g., a shared finance inbox) alongside an individual address.
3. Save the changes. The new address will receive the **next invoice generated** after you save; past invoices are not resent to the new address.
If you have any other questions, just let me know!
